item.tib: rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas kyi dkyil chog rnam mkhyen lam bzang
item.coloph: zhes gsang bdag rta khyung sum dril gyi rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas kyi dkyil 'khor rnam mkhyen lam bzang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ brda' yig rang shar las gsal bar byed po ris bral gter chen brgya rtsa'i phrin las yong la khur blangs gyi na ba gsang sngags gling pas phab pa'o/ yi ge'i byed po khro rigs yid bzhin du 'bod pas ris (bris) so//
